property_summary: For every call to transfer(...), the reference contract returns (does not revert) whenever the _tos array is non-empty; the mutant inverts the length check and will revert for some non-empty _tos, so there exists a fuzzed non-empty _tos where the mutant fails but the reference always succeeds.
change_summary: Change the require from checking _tos.length > 0 to checking equality _tos.length == 0, causing the function to revert for empty _tos in original to succeed and vice versa.
